result.summary: Rework1 resolved all 5 E050 violations (linter exits 0, no code block > 40 lines) and QRY-03 AC2 (page_size: u16 correctly added to EntityQueryResponse). All QRY-01, QRY-02, QRY-03 ACs and QRY-04 ACs 1/2/4/5/6 are covered. MAJOR gap: the rework1 addition of page_size to EntityQueryResponse introduces a new QRY-04 AC3 violation. emptyEnvelope() returns the constant {"items":[],"next_cursor":null} (no page_size field), while the granted+zero-rows path serialises EntityQueryResponse which always includes page_size: u16. These two shapes are structurally distinguishable to the client. QRY-04 AC3 requires the three cases (no grant, unknown entity_key, granted+zero rows) to be indistinguishable. The design must explicitly reconcile this conflict before BACKEND-DEV proceeds.

issues.description: emptyEnvelope() returns {"items":[],"next_cursor":null} with no page_size field. The granted+zero-rows path goes through EntityQueryResponse which includes page_size: u16 (always present, per QRY-03 AC2). A client can distinguish deny/unknown responses (no page_size key) from granted+zero-rows responses (page_size present) by inspecting the JSON object. This violates QRY-04 AC3: 'the three cases are indistinguishable to the client'. The conflict was introduced by rework1 adding page_size to EntityQueryResponse to satisfy QRY-03 AC2 — without updating the emptyEnvelope contract. Proposed resolution options (CODE-DESIGNER must choose and document one): (A) emptyEnvelope() also includes page_size: 50 (the default constant), making it structurally identical to the zero-rows+grant response when no page_size was requested — document that non-default page_size values are NOT reflected in deny responses as an intentional design choice; (B) parse page_size from the request body BEFORE the grant check so emptyEnvelope() can reflect the requested value; (C) make EntityQueryResponse.page_size conditional (omitted when items is empty) and explicitly note that QRY-03 AC2 is satisfied only for non-empty result sets.
